title: CorridorKit: Open-source software for geometric comparison of skull-base surgical corridors
description: CorridorKit is open-source research software for analyzing finite rigid instruments, circular portals, targets, and protected geometry in physical image coordinates. It provides the corridorkit Python package and command-line interface, a desktop application, and a 3D Slicer extension. Retained trajectories, coverage sets, and unavailable-anatomy states support reproducible geometric comparison.
